questions.question: Which gas from a faulty exhaust system is dangerous?
questions.explanation: A leaking exhaust system can let carbon monoxide into the cab. Carbon monoxide is poisonous.

questions.question: Broken suspension parts are:
questions.explanation: The suspension system supports the vehicle and load, and keeps the axles in place. Broken suspension parts are very dangerous.

questions.question: Which one is NOT a type of distraction?
questions.explanation: Driving distractions are physical (like reaching for objects), mental (like talking with passengers), or both (like using a hand-held phone).

questions.question: A loaded trailer with a high center of gravity:

options.text: Gets better gas mileage than an empty trailer.
Is usually more stable than an empty trailer.

questions.explanation: A trailer with a high center of gravity is more likely to roll over than a trailer with a low center of gravity.

questions.question: If your vehicle catches fire, you should NOT:

options.text: Park in an open area away from buildings, trees, brush, and other vehicles.
Call emergency services and tell them your location.

questions.explanation: If your vehicle is on fire, leave the road and stop in an open area. Do not go to a service station because fuel there could catch fire. Call emergency services and report your location.

questions.question: If you realize you will be late to your destination, you should:

options.text: Accept it and drive at a safe speed.

questions.correctAnswerText: Accept it and drive at a safe speed.
questions.explanation: To avoid aggressive driving, manage your stress by accepting your situation. Take a deep breath if you realize you will be late.

questions.question: Texting while driving is compared to talking on a cell phone while driving:
questions.explanation: Texting while driving is more dangerous than talking on a phone. It distracts you mentally and physically.

questions.question: When entering a curve, you should:
questions.explanation: Before entering a curve, slow down to a safe speed and shift to a lower gear.

questions.question: Which surface is the most slippery?
questions.explanation: Wet ice forms when the temperature is just warm enough to melt ice slightly. Wet ice is much more slippery than dry ice.

questions.question: A fatigued driver:

options.text: Is usually more careful than a typical driver.
May be slower to make critical decisions than a typical driver.

questions.correctAnswerText: May be slower to make critical decisions than a typical driver.
questions.explanation: Fatigued drivers react more slowly to hazards. They have difficulty making critical decisions when driving drowsy.

questions.question: What is brake lag?

options.text: The delay between pressing the brake pedal and when the brakes start to work
The distance between the brake pedal and the floor
The amount of air pressure used to stop the vehicle

questions.correctAnswerText: The delay between pressing the brake pedal and when the brakes start to work
questions.explanation: Air brakes cannot work instantly because air needs time to flow through the air lines. There is usually a brake lag of at least half a second between when you press the brake pedal and when the brakes actually start working.

questions.question: Which of the following is not a warning sign of fatigue?
questions.explanation: Warning signs of fatigue include difficulty focusing, heavy eyelids, yawning, rubbing your eyes, daydreaming, trouble remembering the last few miles driven, missing exits or signs, trouble keeping your head up, drifting from your lane, following too closely, hitting shoulder rumble strips, and feeling restless or irritable.

questions.question: When coming to a stop, liquid in a tank may surge. This can:

options.text: Cause the truck to stop too quickly
Cause the truck to be pushed forward

questions.correctAnswerText: Cause the truck to be pushed forward
questions.explanation: When liquid surges in a partially filled tank, the truck gets pushed in the direction of the wave. On a slippery surface, this surge can push the truck forward into an intersection or another vehicle.

questions.question: When inspecting the windshield before a trip, a person should do all of the following, except:

options.text: Remove and sharpen the wiper blades
Check the windshield wipers for proper spring tension
Check the wiper blades for damage

questions.correctAnswerText: Remove and sharpen the wiper blades
questions.explanation: When inspecting your windshield, check for cracks that block your view. Check the wiper arms for proper spring tension and the wiper blades for damage, stiff rubber, and loose connections.

questions.question: To avoid a hazard:

options.text: You should always steer to the left
You may be able to drive onto the shoulder
You should steer sharply in one direction

questions.correctAnswerText: You may be able to drive onto the shoulder
questions.explanation: In an emergency, driving onto the shoulder may be your best way to avoid a hazard. Most shoulders are strong enough to support a large vehicle.

questions.question: What does an air compressor do in an air brake system?

options.text: It pumps air into the air storage tanks
It moves air to the back of the truck

questions.correctAnswerText: It pumps air into the air storage tanks
questions.explanation: In an air brake system, the air compressor pumps air into the air storage tanks. The air compressor governor controls the air compressor.

questions.question: During a trip, landing gear should be:
questions.explanation: Always completely raise the landing gear before you drive. If landing gear is not fully raised, it can catch on railroad tracks or other hazards on the road.

questions.question: Regrooved tires:

options.text: Should not be used on any vehicle
Should not be used on the front of a bus
Should not be used on trucks hauling gravel

questions.correctAnswerText: Should not be used on the front of a bus
questions.explanation: Regrooved, recapped, or retreaded tires are not allowed on the front wheels of a bus.

questions.question: If a tire fails, you should:
questions.explanation: Using the brakes after a tire fails can cause you to lose control. Stay off the brakes if possible until your vehicle has slowed down significantly.

questions.question: Brake linings should be:
questions.explanation: Brake linings should not be loose or soaked with oil or grease. They should not be dangerously thin.
